title: Experiment Poster Extensions
description: Five independent studies extend the experiment-poster theme into science-corner walls, supply kits, standees, tabletop setups, and family take-home sheets.
creative_direction: Independent studies test how the same experiment-education language can span wall displays, kits, take-home supports, and classroom environments without relying on the core poster reference.
